title: Order-Value Allowance in Marketplace Orders Late-Delivery Compensation
content:
**Table rule.** The order-value allowance of the Marketplace Orders late-delivery compensation sums the order-total captures on the order (replacement charges are not order-total captures): captures of at least the high-value floor of USD 400.00 earn the high-value allowance of USD 6.00; captures of at least the mid-value floor of USD 200.00 but below USD 400.00 earn the mid-value allowance of USD 3.00; lower captures earn no order-value allowance.

The allowance is added in full to the late-delivery compensation owed on the order. It is not owed on an order that is owed no late-delivery compensation.

## What is summed

Every payment capture on the order recorded as an order-total capture. Captures recorded as unreturned-replacement charges are left out of the sum.

| Order-total captures on the order | Allowance (USD) |
|---|---|
| USD 400.00 or more | 6.00 |
| USD 200.00 up to USD 399.99 | 3.00 |
| below USD 200.00 | 0.00 |

## Boundary illustrations (hypothetical inputs)

| Captures (example) | Allowance |
|---|---|
| 199.99 | 0.00 |
| 200.00 | 3.00 |
| 399.99 | 3.00 |
| 400.00 | 6.00 |

A hypothetical order with an order-total capture of USD 350.00 and a later unreturned-replacement charge of USD 80.00 sums to USD 350.00 for this rule and earns USD 3.00.
